delta: The trip of Polpaico thermal unit leaves central metropolitan demand exposed, forcing a choice between aggressive local battery dispatch combined with demand management for maximum load recovery versus emergency corridor uprating with northern storage at minimal economic cost.

diagnosis_es: Sudden tripping of the combined-cycle thermal generator at Polpaico causes an acute capacity deficit in the Central Metropolitan Zone and congests the transmission corridor.

options.title_es: Maximum metropolitan reserve and demand response
options.rationale_es: It achieves the highest household restoration while keeping transmission corridor loading well within safe operational limits.

options.title_es: Northern battery reserve with dynamic uprating
options.rationale_es: It avoids operating expenditures and mitigates transmission stress through dynamic thermal ratings despite recovering fewer customer interruptions.
